title: Exchanging a Leopard Cat for a Prince

series.title: Exchanging a Leopard Cat for a Prince

fullText.simplified:
第二十四章、食盒里的孩子

    蓝香给了包拯一个小箱子，她说这是食盒，可以把孩子放在里面。公孙策震惊地问食盒里装的是孩子吗，蓝香却微笑着叫他：“马超，你也来了。”蓝香把公孙策认成了马超。
    “马超？是刘妃宫里的马超吗？”公孙策急问。
    “马超，谢谢你把娘娘的孩子还回来。”蓝香小声说：“我会藏好娘娘的……你们走吧。”
    “藏好？李妃娘娘没有被烧死吗？她活下来了？”包拯吃惊地问。
    “烧……”蓝香又害怕地抱紧了头，哭着说：“他们有刀，他们杀人……”
    “他们是谁？”
    “不……不能说，太可怕了！”
    “他们是太监吗？是刘妃宫里的人吗？是张怀吗？”包拯追问。
    “啊……不要说！”蓝香惊叫一声：“他们会杀了你们的！”
    包拯震惊得说不出话了，公孙策的脸色也很白，他表情复杂地看着包拯，那样子已经不再是担心一个词可以说得清楚的了。
    包拯低头看着手里的箱子，最后问道：“蓝香，食盒里装的是孩子？不是狸猫吗？”
    “狸……“像是听到了什么特别可怕的事情，蓝香惊慌地大哭起来，但她的声音太小了，就算用尽了全身力气，发出的仍然只是低低的声音。终于，她虚弱的身体再也承受不住，她晕倒了。
    包拯和公孙策把她放到床上，为她盖好被子。他们安静地站在床边，一句话也没有说，现在不需要说了，事情已经很清楚了。
    当年李妃生下来的是个普通的孩子，但不知为什么变成了狸猫。李妃被打入冷宫后，张怀进冷宫杀人放火，李妃受伤，被宫女蓝香偷偷救下。刘妃宫里的太监马超把孩子送回给了李妃。为了躲避追杀，楚珠和马超把李妃的孩子放进食盒，想要偷偷带出宫，但在宫门口被高小山发现了。善良的高小山放了他们。张怀追查而来，高小山被杀。
    “李妃生下的那个孩子，如果是男孩，应该就是太子。如果他正常长大，现在应该就是皇帝。如果……”包拯说。
    “不能说了！皇帝只有一个，就是现在宫里的这位！”公孙策急忙打断了他。
    包拯明白公孙策的担心，但他现在没有精力去想这些。他更关心的是，那个孩子现在在哪里？李妃还活着吗？楚珠和马超呢？这些事情和八王爷有什么关系？之前包拯以为绑匪绑架八王爷只是为了让包拯查案，但现在看来，这些事和八王爷也有关系。画里的那个食盒是当年装太子出宫的食盒吗？八王爷知道当年的事吗？
fullText.traditional:
第二十四章、食盒裡的孩子

    藍香給了包拯一個小箱子，她說這是食盒，可以把孩子放在裡面。公孫策震驚地問食盒裡裝的是孩子嗎，藍香卻微笑著叫他：“馬超，你也來了。”藍香把公孫策認成了馬超。
    “馬超？是劉妃宮裡的馬超嗎？”公孫策急問。
    “馬超，謝謝你把娘娘的孩子還回來。”藍香小聲說：“我會藏好娘娘的……你們走吧。”
    “藏好？李妃娘娘沒有被燒死嗎？她活下來了？”包拯吃驚地問。
    “燒……”藍香又害怕地抱緊了頭，哭著說：“他們有刀，他們殺人……”
    “他們是誰？”
    “不……不能說，太可怕了！”
    “他們是太監嗎？是劉妃宮裡的人嗎？是張懷嗎？”包拯追問。
    “啊……不要說！”藍香驚叫一聲：“他們會殺了你們的！”
    包拯震驚得說不出話了，公孫策的臉色也很白，他表情複雜地看著包拯，那樣子已經不再是擔心一個詞可以說得清楚的了。
    包拯低頭看著手裡的箱子，最後問道：“藍香，食盒裡裝的是孩子？不是狸貓嗎？”
    “狸……“像是聽到了什麼特別可怕的事情，藍香驚慌地大哭起來，但她的聲音太小了，就算用盡了全身力氣，發出的仍然只是低低的聲音。終於，她虛弱的身體再也承受不住，她暈倒了。
    包拯和公孫策把她放到床上，為她蓋好被子。他們安靜地站在床邊，一句話也沒有說，現在不需要說了，事情已經很清楚了。
    當年李妃生下來的是個普通的孩子，但不知為什麼變成了狸貓。李妃被打入冷宮後，張懷進冷宮殺人放火，李妃受傷，被宮女藍香偷偷救下。劉妃宮裡的太監馬超把孩子送回給了李妃。為了躲避追殺，楚珠和馬超把李妃的孩子放進食盒，想要偷偷帶出宮，但在宮門口被高小山發現了。善良的高小山放了他們。張懷追查而來，高小山被殺。
    “李妃生下的那個孩子，如果是男孩，應該就是太子。如果他正常長大，現在應該就是皇帝。如果……”包拯說。
    “不能說了！皇帝只有一個，就是現在宮裡的這位！”公孫策急忙打斷了他。
    包拯明白公孫策的擔心，但他現在沒有精力去想這些。他更關心的是，那個孩子現在在哪裡？李妃還活著嗎？楚珠和馬超呢？這些事情和八王爺有什麼關係？之前包拯以為綁匪綁架八王爺只是為了讓包拯查案，但現在看來，這些事和八王爺也有關係。畫裡的那個食盒是當年裝太子出宮的食盒嗎？八王爺知道當年的事嗎？

sentences.simplified: 包拯明白公孙策的担心，但他现在没有精力去想这些。
sentences.traditional: 包拯明白公孫策的擔心，但他現在沒有精力去想這些。
sentences.pinyin: bāo zhěng míng bai gōng sūn cè de dān xīn dàn tā xiàn zài méi yǒu jīng lì qù xiǎng zhè xiē
sentences.english: Bao Zheng understood Gongsun Ce’s concerns, but he didn’t have the energy to think about them right now.

sentences.simplified: 他更关心的是，那个孩子现在在哪里？李妃还活着吗？楚珠和马超呢？
sentences.traditional: 他更關心的是，那個孩子現在在哪裡？李妃還活著嗎？楚珠和馬超呢？
sentences.pinyin: tā gèng guān xīn de shì nà ge hái zi xiàn zài zài nǎ lǐ lǐ fēi hái huó zhe ma chǔ zhū hé mǎ chāo ne
sentences.english: What he cared more about was, where was that child now? Was Consort Li still alive? Where were Chu Zhu and Ma Chao?

sentences.simplified: 这些事情和八王爷有什么关系？
sentences.traditional: 這些事情和八王爺有什麼關係？
sentences.pinyin: zhè xiē shì qing hé bā wáng ye yǒu shén me guān xi
sentences.english: What did these matters have to do with the Eighth Prince?

sentences.simplified: 之前包拯以为绑匪绑架八王爷只是为了让包拯查案，
sentences.traditional: 之前包拯以為綁匪綁架八王爺只是為了讓包拯查案，
sentences.pinyin: zhī qián bāo zhěng yǐ wéi bǎng fěi bǎng jià bā wáng ye zhǐ shì wèi le ràng bāo zhěng chá àn
sentences.english: Previously, Bao Zheng thought that the kidnappers kidnapped the Eighth Prince just to get Bao Zheng to investigate the case.

sentences.simplified: 但现在看来，这些事和八王爷也有关系。
sentences.traditional: 但現在看來，這些事和八王爺也有關係。
sentences.pinyin: dàn xiàn zài kàn lái zhè xiē shì hé bā wáng ye yě yǒu guān xi
sentences.english: But now it seemed that these matters were also related to the Eighth Prince.

sentences.simplified: 画里的那个食盒是当年装太子出宫的食盒吗？
sentences.traditional: 畫裡的那個食盒是當年裝太子出宮的食盒嗎？
sentences.pinyin: huà lǐ de nà ge shí hé shì dāng nián zhuāng tài zǐ chū gōng de shí hé ma
sentences.english: Was the food box in the drawing the same one that was used to take the crown prince out of the palace back then?

sentences.simplified: 八王爷知道当年的事吗？
sentences.traditional: 八王爺知道當年的事嗎？
sentences.pinyin: bā wáng ye zhī dào dāng nián de shì ma
sentences.english: Did the Eighth Prince know about the events of that year?

sentence_translations: Chapter 24: The Child in the Food Box
Lan Xiang gave Bao Zheng a small box. She said it was a food box, and the child could be put inside it.
Gongsun Ce asked in shock if there was a child in the food box, but Lan Xiang just smiled and called him, ..
.. “Ma Chao, you’re here too.” Lan Xiang mistook Gongsun Ce for Ma Chao.
“Ma Chao? Ma Chao from Consort Liu’s palace?” Gongsun Ce asked anxiously.
“Ma Chao, thank you for returning the noble consort’s child,” Lan Xiang said softly, “I will hide the noble consort … You all go ahead.”
“Hide her? Consort Li didn’t burn to death? She survived?” Bao Zheng asked in surprise.
“Burn …” Lan Xiang held her head in fear again, crying, “They had knives, they killed people …”
“Who were they?”
“No … I can’t say, it’s too terrible!”
“Were they eunuchs? Were they people from Consort Liu’s palace? Was it Zhang Huai?” Bao Zheng pressed further.
“Ah … I can’t say!” Lan Xiang screamed, “They will kill you!”
Bao Zheng was too shocked to speak, and Gongsun Ce’s face was also very pale.
He looked at Bao Zheng with a complex expression. The word “worried” could no longer fully describe it.
Bao Zheng looked down at the box in his hands and finally asked, ..
.. “Lan Xiang, is there a child in the food box? It’s not a leopard cat?”
“Leopard …” As if she had heard something particularly terrifying, Lan Xiang started crying in panic, but her voice was too soft.
Even though she used all her strength, the sound she made was still just a low murmur.
Finally, her frail body could no longer bear it, and she fainted.
Bao Zheng and Gongsun Ce put her on the bed and covered her with a quilt.
They stood quietly by the bed, not saying a word. There was no need to speak now. Everything was already clear.
Consort Li gave birth to a normal child, but for some reason, it turned into a leopard cat.
After Consort Li was banished to the Cold Palace, Zhang Huai entered the Cold Palace to commit murder and arson.
Consort Li was injured and secretly rescued by the palace maid, Lan Xiang.
The eunuch Ma Chao in Consort Liu’s palace returned the child to Consort Li.
In order to evade being captured and killed, Chu Zhu and Ma Chao put Consort Li’s child into a food box, ..
.. intending to secretly take him out of the palace, but they were discovered by Gao Xiaoshan at the palace gate.
The kind-hearted Gao Xiaoshan let them go. Zhang Huai tracked him down and Gao Xiaoshan was killed.
“If the child Consort Li gave birth to was a boy, he should have been the crown prince.
If he had grown up normally, he would be the emperor now. If …” Bao Zheng said.
“You can’t say that! There is only one emperor and that is the one in the palace right now!” Gongsun Ce hastily interrupted him.
Bao Zheng understood Gongsun Ce’s concerns, but he didn’t have the energy to think about them right now.
What he cared more about was, where was that child now? Was Consort Li still alive? Where were Chu Zhu and Ma Chao?
What did these matters have to do with the Eighth Prince?
Previously, Bao Zheng thought that the kidnappers kidnapped the Eighth Prince just to get Bao Zheng to investigate the case.
But now it seemed that these matters were also related to the Eighth Prince.
Was the food box in the drawing the same one that was used to take the crown prince out of the palace back then?
Did the Eighth Prince know about the events of that year?
